source: User-supplied macOS crash report, correlated with retained solver command receipt and stderr. Unrelated machine identifiers and full binary inventory are not copied into this index.
stderr: has no face descriptor: fd.size = 0, ind = 1
cause: The first hand-built 2D pilot omitted required face descriptors before adding triangular surface elements. Netgen crashed on that invalid mesh input instead of raising a Python exception.
correction: structured_mesh in ngsolve_periodic_ac.py creates descriptors for all three regions before any Element2D is added.
verification: Subsequent actual mesh-construction/periodic-boundary tests and numerous nonlinear-bias/harmonic solver runs passed that construction stage. The original crash receipt stays failed.
scope_boundaries: OpenChamber is the responsible launcher in the OS report, not the faulting native component.
This identifies the early mesh-construction segfault, not the cause of earlier GetDP/postprocessing SIGTERM interruptions.
The report is not evidence of an OOM termination, solver nonconvergence or invalidation of later completed studies.
